resources.string: The guardian checks and restores your custom settings.

Default (0) follows the device configuration. Voice-centric (1) prioritizes voice availability during network selection; data-centric (2) prioritizes data availability. This does not set download priority, bands or aggregation. Switching uses the current guardian authorization. Stop, edit or undo restores the captured original setting.

Select a preference to apply it

An original usage preference still needs recovery, or its record could not be read. Reauthorize with the original SIM present. Restore it before uninstalling, clearing app data or returning to the stable APK.
